relations.D2: first weekday >= R+9 with no planning of HP3 on D2-1 and D2
relations.D3: first weekday >= R+5 with no planning of HP4
relations.DW: first weekday >= R+14 in an open planning period

PLACEHOLDERS.GA_NODE: Gruppe node of G-A (Pflege Medizin on DM-Y): KNOTEN_ID
PLACEHOLDERS.GA_NAME: name of the G-A plan sheet as shown in the planner app
PLACEHOLDERS.GA_STATION: Station of G-A that holds pool P-A (KNOTEN_ID and name)
PLACEHOLDERS.GB_NODE: Gruppe node of G-B (Geburtshilfe on DM-Y): KNOTEN_ID
PLACEHOLDERS.GB_STATION: Station of G-B that holds pool P-B (KNOTEN_ID and name)
PLACEHOLDERS.DEF_EARLY: PA code of the POMA-type EARLY Dienst in G-A's palette (definitions kit)
PLACEHOLDERS.DEF_NIGHT: PA code of the POMA-type NIGHT Dienst in G-A's palette (definitions kit)
PLACEHOLDERS.DEF_IP_JA: PA code of PSP-IP-JA (INTERNER_POOL T, RESSOURCENERSATZ F)
PLACEHOLDERS.DEF_IP_NEIN: PA code of PSP-IP-NEIN (INTERNER_POOL F, RESSOURCENERSATZ T)
PLACEHOLDERS.DEF_WUNSCH_JA: PA code of PSP-WUNSCH-JA (PLANUNGSWUNSCH on DIENST and on the G-A DIENST_DETAIL)
PLACEHOLDERS.DEF_WUNSCH_NEIN: PA code of PSP-WUNSCH-NODE-NEIN (PLANUNGSWUNSCH only on DIENST)
PLACEHOLDERS.M1: month after the run date, YYYY-MM
PLACEHOLDERS.BUNDLE_LINE: master or main-26 (PSP-20 expectations differ per line)
PLACEHOLDERS.PORTAL_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's portal-ops browser profile folder (outside results/)
